title: Changes from people and bots reach main only after tests and a review

parts.name: Contributors
parts.details: Pull requests opened by people on the team.

parts.name: Update bots
parts.details: Pull requests that raise the version of a dependency.

parts.name: Tests
parts.details: The test suite runs on each pull request. A failing one goes back to its author.
parts.example: Sent back: a change that broke the login test

parts.name: Reviewer
parts.details: A reviewer reads the change and approves it or asks for changes.

parts.name: Sent back
parts.details: Pull requests that wait for their author, with the reason.

parts.name: main
parts.details: Approved pull requests are merged into main.

parts.name: Production
parts.details: Deploying is a separate step that a person starts.
